outcomes: Acquire the skills necessary for workforce preparation in the field of system administration, helpdesk and technical support, including Windows Active Directory and Linux administration, network user management, technical and helpdesk support, server and network management, system maintenance, monitoring and troubleshooting, and IT and data center operations.

programs.title: Technical Director
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
outcomes: Have skills needed to work competently in the scene shop of a working theatre. These include, but are not limited to: Woodworking, construction, carpentry and drafting.

programs.title: Theatre Arts
programs.award: A.A- T Degree
outcomes: Upon completion of this degree students will have entry-level knowledge in the world of general theatre, which includes careers in performance and production. This degree also allows them to further their knowledge in a 4-year institution.

programs.title: Theatre Arts Performance
programs.award: A.A. Degree
outcomes: Upon completion students will have comprehensive understanding of story, analysis, and performative obligations. Students will have demonstrated and embodied character, presence, instinct, action, objective, and obstacle.
Upon completion students will obtain the knowledge necessary to understand the broad theatrical landscape, preparing them for entry into the industry.

programs.title: Theatre Design
programs.award: A.S. Degree
outcomes: Upon completion of the design degree students should be able to demonstrate entry-level knowledge in the theatre design emphasis of their choosing. This includes lighting, scenery, projections, sound, costumes and makeup.
Upon completion of this degree students should be able to demonstrate knowledge in current theatre design equipment/gear, and produce industry standard work.

programs.title: Tourism and Conference Management Basic
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
outcomes: A student who completes this program will acquire the practical knowledge and technical training necessary for employment as a professional meeting and event coordinators.

programs.title: Travel/Tourism
programs.award: A.S. Degree
outcomes: A student who completes this program will acquire the practical knowledge and technical training necessary for pursuing a career as a travel agent, tour guide, or corporate travel consultant.

programs.title: Travel/Tourism Advanced
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units
outcomes: A student who completes this program will develop an advanced understanding of the practical knowledge and technical training necessary for pursuing a career as a travel agent, tour guide, or corporate travel consultant.

programs.title: Travel/Tourism Basic
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
outcomes: A student who completes this program will develop a basic understanding of the travel industry and the sales, security, and service requirements necessary to work in the travel industry.

programs.title: UAS Remote Pilot
programs.award: A.S. Degree
outcomes: Students will conduct independent study documenting through research and field experience.

Students will plan and successfully fly a UAS/Drone flight within regulatory guidelines, with 70% or better accuracy scores. Assessment:Computer tracking and UAS/Drone flight data readouts will allow assessment of the completed flight, which will be documented in the students' career portfolio. Students will achieve a 70% or better in proficiency.
Acquire the knowledge necessary to pass the FAA Part 107 exam.

programs.title: UAS Remote Pilot  Advanced
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
outcomes: acquire workforce preparation skills, including weather interpretation, application of regulations, aeronautical decision-making, airport operations, and performance calculations necessary for a career as a drone pilot that exceed the knowledge on the FAA Remote Pilot Exam.

programs.title: UAS Remote Pilot Basic
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
outcomes: acquire workforce preparation skills, including weather interpretation, application of regulations, aeronautical decision-making, airport operations, and performance calculations necessary for a career as a drone pilot and to pass the FAA Remote Pilot Knowledge Exam.

programs.title: UCTP Chemistry
programs.award: A.S. T Degree
outcomes: Acquire the knowledge and skills, including the principles and applications of general and organic chemistry, experimental techniques and safety protocols in laboratory, necessary for transfer to a four-year institution.

programs.title: Ultrasonic Scaling and Coronal Polishing
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units
outcomes: Be able to provide patients with dental hygiene process of care in disease prevention and oral health promotion utilizing knowledge, skills, and values.
Serve in professional relationships within the community in which they serve.
Participate in a relationship amongst the allied health care team.
Be prepared to provide professional knowledge of and compliance with OSHA, HIPAA, Law and Ethics, Dental Hygiene Board of California, and local regulatory guidelines.
Adhere to professional sensitivity to the patient’s autonomy, beneficence, and nonmaleficence principles of ethical practice.

programs.title: Victimology
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units
outcomes: Acquire the workforce preparation skills, knowledge, and competencies including the network of agencies available for victims and perpetrators, resources for victims of violent and non-violent crimes, and the costs of victimization in our society necessary for entry-level employment and/or career advancement within advancement within mental health agencies, senior centers, and social services agencies, schools, juvenile justice agencies and community agencies.

programs.title: Virtualization and Cloud Computing
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
outcomes: Have a basic understanding of virtualization and cloud infrastructure, be familiar with general IT infrastructure and how it relates to cloud services, provision virtual machines and storage solutions in the cloud, design and troubleshoot cloud-based systems and networks and be prepared for the AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification exam.

programs.title: Yoga Teacher Training (200-hour)
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units
outcomes: Acquire skills and knowledge that include functional anatomy, physiology, meditation, mindfulness, posture, and breathing practice, and prepare student for a career as a yoga teacher

programs.title: Yoga Therapy  (300-hr)
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
outcomes: Acquire skills and knowledge to assess and implement specific modalities across all kosha layers of the individual to aid wellness.
